title: Masked AI call forces Parkview High into soft lockdown

reports.title: Parkview High receives 4th AI-generated bomb threat this year
Hoax phone call at Gwinnett high school causes lockdown; campus cleared
Masked AI call forces Parkview High into soft lockdown

summary:
Parkview High School in Gwinnett County, Georgia, received its fourth bomb threat of the current school year on Monday. School officials believe the threat was created using artificial intelligence. As a precaution, the school was placed on lockdown, but it later returned to normal operations. The lockdown was lifted after a search. No bombs were found and no one was hurt.

Gwinnett County school police are now working with the Georgia Bureau of Investigation and the FBI to find out who is responsible. In a letter to parents, police said the latest threat came from a masked phone number, which matches a pattern from earlier threats this year. No arrests have been made and no suspect has been identified. Investigators are continuing their work.
